newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hashimoto says fast change in forex unwelcome - Jiji.
newsitem.headline: Hashimoto says fast change in forex unwelcome - Jiji.

text.p: Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto was quoted by Jiji news agency on Wednesday as saying he did not welcome rapid changes in foreign exchange levels, adding that recent movements in currencies reflected the dollar's strength.

"I have not yet been briefed properly (on the overnight rise in the dollar to over 121 yen), but the recent trend is for a strong dollar. I don't welcome fast changes, and that's the problem," Jiji quoted Hashimoto as telling reporters.
